[SWS_DM_01459]
SOVD
data representation of textual Strings
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04256
⌈
The atomic subset of a SOVD request or response body matching a
Diag-
nosticSovdContentElement
with
DiagnosticSovdPrimitiveContentEle-
ment.swDataDefProps
with
baseTypeEncoding
of
ISO-8859-1
,
ISO-8859-
2
,
WINDOWS-1252
,
UTF-8
,
UTF-16
or
UCS-2
as defined in Diagnostic Extract
Template[4] shall be of type
string
and the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall
make the conversion based on the encodings to match the charset defined by ASAM
SOVD[5][14][13].
⌋
